policies.name: case_scope_metadata_read
policies.using:
((admin_id = ap_m1.ctx_admin()) AND ap_m1.has_admin_permission('SUPPORT_REPLY'::text) AND (revoked_at IS NULL) AND (valid_from <= statement_timestamp()) AND (valid_until > statement_timestamp()) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM ap_m1.admin_cases c
  WHERE ((c.id = admin_case_scopes.case_id) AND (c.child_id = admin_case_scopes.child_id) AND (c.case_status = 'APPROVED_METADATA'::text)))))

policies.name: snapshots_r
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM ap_m1.devices d
  WHERE ((d.id = capability_snapshots.device_id) AND ap_m1.has_child_scope_v2(d.child_id, 'VIEW_CHILD_DEVICES'::text))))

policies.name: pickup_pass_owner_read
policies.using: ((created_by = ap_m1.ctx_principal()) AND ap_m1.has_child_scope_v2(child_id, 'VIEW_LOCATION'::text) AND ap_m1.has_consent(child_id, 'LOCATION'::text) AND (NOT ap_m1.child_deleted(child_id)))

policies.name: cmds_r
policies.using: ((ap_m1.has_child_scope_v2(child_id, 'MANAGE_COMMANDS'::text) OR (ap_m1.owns_active_device(device_id) AND (expires_at > statement_timestamp()))) AND ap_m1.has_consent(child_id, 'CORE'::text) AND (NOT ap_m1.child_deleted(child_id)))

policies.name: consent_document_read
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM ap_m1.consent_policy_versions p
  WHERE ((p.id = consent_documents.policy_id) AND (p.state = 'APPROVED'::text) AND (p.effective_from <= now()))))

policies.name: health_r
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM ap_m1.devices d
  WHERE ((d.id = device_health.device_id) AND ap_m1.has_child_scope_v2(d.child_id, 'VIEW_CHILD_DEVICES'::text))))

policies.name: latest_read
policies.using: (ap_m1.has_child_scope_v2(child_id, 'VIEW_LOCATION'::text) AND ap_m1.has_consent(child_id, 'LOCATION'::text) AND (NOT ap_m1.child_deleted(child_id)) AND ((observed_at >= (statement_timestamp() - '06:00:00'::interval)) AND (observed_at <= statement_timestamp())))

policies.name: faq_revision_read
policies.using:
(ap_m1.has_admin_permission('FAQ_EDIT'::text) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM ap_m1.faq_entries e
  WHERE ((e.id = faq_revisions.faq_id) AND (e.state = 'PUBLISHED'::text) AND (e.published_revision_id = faq_revisions.id)))))

policies.name: approval_read
policies.using: ((NOT ap_m1.child_deleted(child_id)) AND ap_m1.has_consent(child_id, 'MEDIA'::text) AND (ap_m1.has_child_scope_v2(child_id, 'VIEW_MEDIA'::text) OR ap_m1.owns_active_device(device_id)))

policies.name: personal_notification_read
policies.using: ((adult_id = ap_m1.ctx_principal()) AND ((child_id IS NULL) OR (ap_m1.has_child_scope_v2(child_id, 'VIEW_ALERTS'::text) AND (NOT ap_m1.child_deleted(child_id)))))

policies.name: observed_history_read
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM ap_m1.trip_revisions r
  WHERE ((r.child_id = stops.child_id) AND (r.trip_id = stops.trip_id) AND (r.revision = stops.revision))))

policies.name: parent_message
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM ap_m1.support_tickets t
  WHERE ((t.id = support_messages.ticket_id) AND (t.requester_id = ap_m1.ctx_principal()))))

policies.name: tracking_read
policies.using: ((NOT ap_m1.child_deleted(child_id)) AND ap_m1.has_consent(child_id, 'LOCATION'::text) AND (ap_m1.has_child_scope_v2(child_id, 'VIEW_CHILD_DEVICES'::text) OR ap_m1.owns_active_device(device_id)))

policies.name: observed_history_read
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM ap_m1.trip_revisions r
  WHERE ((r.child_id = trip_legs.child_id) AND (r.trip_id = trip_legs.trip_id) AND (r.revision = trip_legs.revision))))
